publication_model: Editorial prepublication checks followed by transparent post-publication peer review

verified_points: Brief Reports are short descriptions of observations, preliminary studies or protocols.
The main body must be concise and no more than 2500 words.
The standard structure is Introduction, Methods, Results and Conclusions or Discussion.
Methods should permit repetition and discuss bias controls and dataset limitations.
Results require underlying data in the article or a public repository.
The discussion should address existing literature, strengths, weaknesses and future directions.
A Data and Software Availability statement is required.
F1000Research does not accept supplementary material.
Prepublication checks cover author criteria, article type, originality, language and readability, methods, policies, data availability and ethics compliance.
Unresolved prepublication-check concerns can prevent publication.

review_axes: Brief Report scope and article-type fit
criteria_not_used: No broad-interest, prestige or field-transforming-impact threshold is imposed by the verified Brief Report guidance.
unresolved_human_filing_inputs: Persistent public archive identifier for the frozen data and software deposit
Author affiliation, identity and ORCID confirmation
Licence, AI-policy, fee and submission-portal declarations
Independent author confirmation of the table, formula and final wording
scope_note: The criteria card governs this simulation only. It does not predict a real editor's decision and it does not convert unresolved human filing inputs into scientific defects.
